description: e2e_le2_launcher plus a watch of the real monitor (mean/centre colour every ~120 ms, a few screenshots) while the game runs: the 'blue-black' flicker.

app.command: mkdir %USERPROFILE%\vision-alvr\runs\watch4 2>nul & _tmp\lb\dist\libovr_launch.exe --texture-budget 2 "C:\Games\Lone Echo2\bin\win10\loneecho2.exe" & timeout /t 25 /nobreak >nul & powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File _tmp\watch.ps1 %USERPROFILE%\vision-alvr\runs\watch4 40 > %USERPROFILE%\vision-alvr\runs\watch4\watch.txt 2>&1 & taskkill /f /im loneecho2.exe
